_doc: LANCE-19 batch 2: Legion MBT (RGriffin65), tracked. Wheel circles read off the skirt cut-outs of the level fit.
notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 2, 2026-10-30), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. TRACKED. The kit's hull was split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (legion_prep.json) into the hull, the turret (`Legion_turret`, turns about its dome centre), the two big barrels with their small flanking ones (`gun`, a node the original lacks: weapon_01 re-parented under it; the original's weapon_02..04 are side pods on the turret and stay on it) and two track belts (the faces within 140 mm of the closed belt path round the wheels). The 7 wheels a side (`wheel_l0`..`wheel_r6`: 6 road wheels and the rear sprocket) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`) on axles fitted to the skirt cut-outs; the kit's wheel faces were cut from the hull. Belts on a tread strip of two link pitches (0.44 m). welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 1.5 degrees (8 degrees collapsed the big hull plates into crumpled sheets), collapse only above 90k faces a part.
